rationale: The Portal impression callback emits an outdated hardcoded catalog identifier while cards and header derive from the current30-entry gameCatalog. This is an implementation metadata mismatch. The existing sanitizer accepts active30-2026-10-08; runtime carries it into a gated coarse impression event and Worker stores it in data_json. Existing aggregates and admin/Codex query filters do not branch on catalog_version, and GA does not map game_card_impression. No gameplay, save, auth, ingestion schema or emission gate depends on active29. Minimal interpolation from gameCatalog.length corrects metadata without changing those rules. The wrong label degrades version evidence but does not itself cause operation-blocking or major release risk.
